title: Bosnia and Herzegovina National Adaptation Plan – NAP with proposed measures
organization: Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Relations of Bosnia and Herzegovina, with UNDP and entity ministries
temporal_coverage: Observed climate analysis through 2018, historical hazards, and projections through the end of the 21st century.
methodology: Synthesizes climate records, sector studies and climate-model projections.
limitations: The plan notes pending national analyses; proposed measures are not implementation evidence.

title: Bosnia and Herzegovina Floods, 2014: Recovery Needs Assessment
organization: Government of Bosnia and Herzegovina with the European Union, United Nations and World Bank
temporal_coverage: Assesses the 14–19 May 2014 floods and recovery needs identified by June 2014.
methodology: Authorities, EU, UN and World Bank combined records, visits and rapid surveys.
limitations: Findings use information available by June 2014.

title: Bosnia and Herzegovina Disaster Resilience Scorecard Assessment and Public Health Scorecard Addendum Analysis: Gaps, Challenges and Recommendations
organization: United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction
temporal_coverage: Reports local scorecards and DRR activities during 2021–2022.
methodology: UNDRR analyzed municipal self-assessments and public-health scorecards.
limitations: Selected local self-assessments, not an independent implementation evaluation.

title: INFORM Subnational Risk Index for Bosnia and Herzegovina: Findings on natural hazard exposure, vulnerability and coping capacities, and recommendations for disaster risk management
organization: United Nations University Institute for Environment and Human Security, guided by the European Commission Joint Research Centre INFORM methodology
temporal_coverage: Municipal index published June 2026; includes historical disaster and war-legacy indicators.
limitations: DRR capability and humanitarian coping indicators were excluded for insufficient data.

title: Bosnia and Herzegovina Floods Response – Multi-Cluster Initial Rapid Assessment
organization: United Nations in Bosnia and Herzegovina, coordinated by the International Organization for Migration
temporal_coverage: Rapid assessment of the 4 October 2024 storm, based on interviews conducted 2–6 November 2024.
methodology: Light assessment based on 87 local key-informant interviews.
limitations: Indicative sample; figures not independently verified.
